body:
Real, native SHADER_IPS_LIGHT: a genuinely unlit emissive shader (not an additive highlight on lit color like SHADER_STANDARD) -- forces a box's base tint/lighting to full bright before texturing, skipping day/night darkening + ground AO entirely, plus a real soft fresnel-ish additive GLSL glow on top. New proctex_make_ips_panel_rgba gives it a distinct fine pixel-grid IPS-panel texture instead of falling back to brick. Closed a real, found-live gap along the way: level_boxes.h already parsed each material's shader_name from level JSON but phys_set_custom_level_materials silently dropped it before it ever reached the renderer -- now threaded through end to end. NOCK's Materials panel gets a real shader picker (standard/ips_light) and the per-material Delete button is removed entirely so a hooked-up material can't be accidentally orphaned from its shader. Created the real ips_light material (id=5) via the live MaterialStore, confirmed via GET /api/v1/shankpit-materials. Live-verified via Xvfb: an ips_light test wall renders as an unmistakably distinct bright glowing panel next to a normal brick wall. Commits SHANKPIT 0a5bf71, IDUNA 8d7f2fa.

⚓ ☃
title: Add SHADER_IPS_LIGHT emissive material + lock materials panel delete
